Title: User successfully requests OTP and receives it via email in the response header
Preconditions: User has a valid email address registered in the system
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/auth/request-otp with the query parameter 'email' set to a valid registered email address.

Test Data: {"email": "user@example.com"}
Expected Result: Response status code is 200. The response body contains the message 'OTP Sent to Your Email'. The 'OTP' header contains the generated OTP value.
